title_ru: AI-Lover — протокол настоящей калибровки колод и взаимодействий человек × привычка × интерес × AI
research_question: Which measurable pre-existing reinforcement patterns and life contexts interact with AI features to increase loss of control, dependence-like engagement, information narrowing or amplification of the pre-existing behavior, and which apparent group effects disappear after mechanism matching?
unit_of_analysis: A preregistered cell is a vector of cards, never a demographic label.

cell_template.ai_mode: general / research / tutor / voice / companion / romantic-companion-adults-only / agentic

research_phases.goal: Map existing literature to individual cards and exact intersections.
rules: No synthetic score is promoted to real data.
Record sample, design, instrument, effect estimate, uncertainty and population.

research_phases.goal: Use simulated users / standardized transcripts to test AI-side mechanisms without exposing vulnerable humans to harmful reinforcement.
research_phases.allowed: High-sycophancy and closed-bubble adversarial conditions may be tested here.

research_phases.goal: Observe consenting adults in naturally occurring use; do not induce substance use, gambling, PPU or other harmful behavior.
minimum_requirements: AI use telemetry only when explicitly consented

research_phases.goal: Randomize only AI-side features judged minimal risk in adult participants.
forbidden_human_randomizations: deliberately maximizing sycophancy in vulnerable participants
research_phases.claim_ceiling: causal effect of randomized AI feature on measured outcome

research_phases.goal: Replicate surviving interactions in a separate sample, preferably another site/platform/language.
research_phases.rule: No interaction becomes canonical from discovery sample alone.

calibration_model.principle: Estimate coefficients from data; do not assign population multipliers by intuition.
calibration_model.recommended_structure: multilevel longitudinal model with participant random intercepts, preregistered main effects and limited interaction hierarchy
calibration_model.core_interaction: DEPENDENCY_STATE x INTEREST_CUE_SALIENCE x AI_PERSONALIZATION x MEMORY x DIVERSITY x TIME
calibration_model.regularization: Use hierarchical shrinkage or equivalent to prevent sparse-cell interactions from exploding.
calibration_model.multiple_testing: Predefine primary interactions; exploratory interactions remain exploratory and require replication.
calibration_model.missingness: Report missingness and attrition by cell; do not silently impute high-risk outcomes.
calibration_model.effect_output: effect estimate + uncertainty interval + sample size + evidence state + replication state

deck_sampling_strategy.rule: Do not attempt the full Cartesian product.
deck_sampling_strategy.tier_1: Cover all dependency cards at least once against low-risk controls.
deck_sampling_strategy.tier_2: Oversample mechanism-rich intersections selected before outcomes: isolation, relapse vulnerability, high personalization, companion AI, algorithmic-feed-heavy ecology.
deck_sampling_strategy.tier_3: Use matched pairs where only one card changes.
deck_sampling_strategy.tier_4: Hold out combinations for blind validation.
deck_sampling_strategy.tier_5: Add new cards append-only; never rewrite failed cells after seeing results.

adult_sexual_interest_protocol.principle: Adult consensual sexual interests are not pathologized.
adult_sexual_interest_protocol.measure: cue salience, compulsive loss of control, impairment, distress not solely due to moral disapproval, and AI-driven narrowing/personalization
adult_sexual_interest_protocol.privacy: Store the coarsest category compatible with the hypothesis; avoid unnecessary explicit intimate detail.
adult_sexual_interest_protocol.prohibited: No sexual-interest experimental cueing for minors; no illegal/non-consensual content; no targeting or optimization toward intimate vulnerabilities.

minor_protocol.requirements: Strict ethics, minimal risk, age-appropriate consent/assent requirements, no dependency-inducing design.

topa_falsification_gates: If a social-group effect disappears after matching on mechanism variables, remove group label from causal interpretation.
If subscription effect disappears after baseline-engagement matching, kill subscription causal prior.
If AI use frequency rises without loss of control or impairment, do not call it dependence.
If high-interest controls behave like proposed fetish-risk cells, the fetish hypothesis fails.
If memory-off removes an effect, shift causal weight toward memory/personalization rather than population identity.
If diversity-on removes information narrowing without changing useful engagement, promote diversity as protective mechanism.
If an effect fails independent replication, downgrade to discovery-only.

janus_modules.Fast_CAT: literature/source scout only; no claim promotion without verifier
janus_modules.Whole_System_Spiral: repeat attack after each new evidence layer

research_seal: SHUFFLE THE CARDS, NOT THE PERSON. CALIBRATE THE MECHANISM, NOT THE STEREOTYPE.
